---
title: "Flat Hierarchy"
format:
  html:
    theme: journal
params:
  db_path: "../data/vpro.duckdb"
  parquet_dir: ""
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(duckdb)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

options(knitr.table.format = "html")
parquet_dir <- params$parquet_dir
if (!is.null(parquet_dir) && nzchar(trimws(parquet_dir))) {
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = ":memory:")
  tbls <- c("Sample_Hierarchy")
  for (tbl in tbls) {
    file_name <- paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", tbl), ".parquet")
    file_path <- file.path(parquet_dir, file_name)
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      dbExecute(
        con,
        sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('%s')", tbl, gsub("'", "''", file_path))
      )
    }
  }
} else {
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), params$db_path, read_only = TRUE)
}
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
hier <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT ID, Name, Parent, Level, Tag FROM Sample_Hierarchy ORDER BY Parent, Name")
normalize_hier_cols <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(df)
  cols <- names(df)
  pick_col <- function(candidates) {
    idx <- which(tolower(cols) %in% tolower(candidates))
    if (length(idx) > 0) cols[[idx[1]]] else NA_character_
  }
  id_col <- pick_col(c("id", "ID"))
  name_col <- pick_col(c("name", "Name"))
  parent_col <- pick_col(c("parent", "Parent"))
  level_col <- pick_col(c("level", "Level"))
  tag_col <- pick_col(c("tag", "Tag"))
  if (!is.na(id_col)) df$ID <- df[[id_col]]
  if (!is.na(name_col)) df$Name <- df[[name_col]]
  if (!is.na(parent_col)) df$Parent <- df[[parent_col]]
  if (!is.na(level_col)) df$Level <- df[[level_col]]
  if (!is.na(tag_col)) df$Tag <- df[[tag_col]]
  df
}

hier <- normalize_hier_cols(hier)
dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```

# Hierarchy (Flat)

```{r hierarchy-table, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (nrow(hier) > 0) {
  kbl(hier, align = "l") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No hierarchy records found.")
}
```
